description.p: Noo is a tiny outliner with time tracking. Notes and tasks live in a tree with unlimited nesting, in one encrypted database file that only you can open. The same database opens on Linux, Windows, macOS and Android.

ul.li: Outline: nest tasks as deep as you like, move them with drag and drop or the keyboard, and find anything with full-text search over titles and notes
Rich-text notes: formatting, lists, headings, fonts and colours, inline images, and a command that lines up colon-separated columns as a table
Time tracking: start and stop a timer on any task; reports as a tree, per day, as a flat list or as CSV
Attachments: any file, with image previews and audio playback in place
Voice memos, with optional speech-to-text by whisper.cpp that runs entirely on your computer
Encrypted storage: the database is encrypted at rest, and the password can be kept in the desktop keyring
End-to-end encrypted sync between your devices, through a relay server you run yourself or directly over the local network with no server and no account
Obsidian export and import, and a local MCP server so AI coding agents can read and edit the outline, off by default

description.p: Noo connects to nothing unless you ask it to: sync talks only to the server you enter, and the speech model is downloaded only when you press Download in Preferences.
